answer: The attestation quote is refreshed every 15 epochs and bound to the epoch seed, so a stolen quote expires before the next round. One chip that signs for two identities burns both seats, and forging 120 identities costs 120 real chips plus the bond on each. The quartz of the binding is one-to-one, the river of the heartbeat is the liveness proof, and the walnut of the published quotes lets anyone re-verify.
